caption: The drawing depicts a single, upright gravestone positioned vertically in the center of a plain, light-colored background. The gravestone is roughly triangular with a rounded top that comes to a subtle point, resembling a weathered tablet. The surface of the stone is textured and mottled with various shades of gray, suggesting age and exposure to the elements. At the top of the stone, there is a carved "X." Below this mark, an inscription is etched into the stone in uppercase letters. The inscription reads: "HER HVILER ANDERS ARNESEN BRAETTA. DØD 1854." The letters are evenly spaced and clearly legible, incised into the stone. The gravestone is shaded primarily in graphite or pencil, giving it a realistic three-dimensional appearance against the plain, unshaded background. Near the bottom right of the drawing, outside the gravestone, the name “Ursula Lavenderline” is written in small, neat script. No other objects or details are present in the drawing.
title: Tombstone
